description: Audit documentation gaps by comparing code changes between the last docs update (or release version) and current HEAD. Detects undocumented features, modified tools/skills, configuration changes, and KO-EN translation parity drift. Use when checking for missing documentation, auditing doc gaps, verifying translation parity, or preparing documentation before releases. Triggers on: "audit docs", "audit-docs", "문서 누락 검토", "문서 누락 감사", "docs audit", "문서 드리프트 감사", "마지막 docs 업데이트 분석".
